name: Wingback
long_description: Wingback provides tools and APIs for SaaS pricing and packaging. We are infrastructure that allows SaaS startups to deploy any set of features of their product using any pricing model. It enables non-technical teams to implement pricing and packaging changes and execute product-led growth campaigns without engineering involvement.
one_liner: Wingback provides tools and APIs for SaaS pricing and packaging.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: I've been fascinated by technology since early childhood, which led me to founding 1aim, an IoT startup. I ran 1aim together with my co-founder Yann for seven years before it was acquired. After that, I provided advice to some founder friends. In late 2020, I joined On Deck. After many conversations with On Deck fellows in SaaS, Yann and I started building Wingback. Besides startups, I'm interested in Formula 1, cars, and planes, but also in architecture, fashion, and history.
